title: Develop minimap at 200% and above
objective: Deliver a bounded whole-image overview with a visible-region rectangle and owner-chosen click/drag navigation at percentage zoom >=200, through existing view.set state, with native rendered evidence and declared-tolerance GPU correctness.
context_summary: The owner requested a plan, not implementation. The inclusive 200% threshold is explicit. The owner chose click-to-jump and dragging the viewport rectangle. Lower-right placement and other layout/engineering defaults remain proposed recommendations; implementation awaits a separate instruction. Routine sizes, styling and code organization are delegated within the design contract. No external inputs block working delivery: use generated 24 MP/60 MP images and current supplied RAW fixtures; missing native Windows/Linux evidence stays unrun. Geometry/API projection and overview rendering are independent outputs consumed by integration. Re-review against current main and use the roadmap high-tier model minimum. No implementation approval, owner-review or research task is inserted.

tasks.description: Define shared minimap placement, viewport projection and pan conversion using the existing view command.
extra_context: Deliver pure geometry/model helpers consumed by TASK-003; do not build the widget or change authoritative recipe state.
Use exact stored percentage >=200, not rounded text; Fit is always ineligible. Reuse or factor existing percentage placement, centred axes, crop-box and effective scale arithmetic.
The command is already view.set; clarify existing pan units/origin in its registered schema and prove same-client session parity. No new view persistence or minimap method.
Implementer chooses helper boundaries and routine responsive layout within the design. Minimap chrome is fixed to the viewport and never changes scroll extents.

acceptance_criteria: Visibility boundary covers Fit, 199.9, 200, 200.1 and 1600 regardless of display rounding.

An independent geometric oracle agrees with normalized visible bounds and inverse click/drag pan for portrait/landscape, centred fitting axes, edges, letterboxing, crop box, effective 1x/2x and interface scale.
Degenerate dimensions/nonfinite data yield no actionable geometry; pan clamps without drifting on a fitting axis.
Existing view.set schema describes its actual pan units; equivalent pan requests have identical per-client ViewState and no edit/history/content-generation change.

steps: Run focused existing view tests and add non-mirroring projection tests with hand-computed coordinates and edge cases.
Inspect the schema discovery response and test session isolation using independent clients.
expected_results: Projection and schema/session tests pass; no renderer work, recipe mutation or new durable state is introduced.

tasks.description: Provide a bounded, identity-keyed whole-stage overview from the existing GPU tile sweep and reference fallback.
extra_context: Deliver the overview result/lifecycle and narrow surface presentation seam consumed by TASK-003. No second source residency, GPU device or full-photo texture.

High-zoom RestTiles currently have no reduction: add a distinct overview output while preserving the full-detail main region and histogram counts. Reuse final chained/staged tile work, light sweeps, output encoding and existing cancellation/visibility wakes.
For a first eligible view without an overview, one existing bounded sweep is permitted if the histogram sweep already completed; ordinary pan/zoom with valid content must reuse the overview.

Crop draft uses the rotated input-stage box; Compare uses fixed After, held Before its matching Original and uncropped hold its own geometry. Reference overview reduction borrows the already-required frame on a worker.

Cap raster dimensions at 256x256 physical pixels, total new GPU allocations at 4 MiB inside the existing preview budget and total CPU buffers/scratch at 1 MiB. Account replacement/retirement before allocation.

Keep one current overview and one replacement at most; content identity excludes pan and high-zoom percentage with unchanged bounds. During edit motion retain the last settled overview labelled Updating; remove geometrically incompatible imagery.

acceptance_criteria: Ready overviews cover the entire selected edited stage, including geometry, and match an independently reduced whole-frame reference within the declared display tolerance; CPU reduction is exact.
Both chained and staged sweeps, light-sweep fallback, RAW, crop-stage, history and comparison identities work without changing main-view detail or full-image histogram meaning.
Unchanged pan or high-zoom percentage reuses pixels with zero overview rebuild/upload and no overview-only full-frame CPU render.
Late results and budget exhaustion cannot show the wrong photo/stage; geometry mismatch disables navigation; non-geometric draft motion keeps visibly Updating settled imagery.

All new current/replacement/scratch/retiring storage remains inside caps; attribution, reuse/rebuild diagnostics and lifecycle release are testable, with no new idle timer or retained RAW source ownership.

steps: Add focused reduction/coverage fixtures, sharing tests, identity invalidation tests and capacity/retirement/cancellation tests.
Compare overview output against CPU whole-frame reduction for pointwise, geometry and spatial stacks using a native GPU where available; skips remain explicit.
Exercise exhausted budgets and explicit no-GPU/reference paths; inspect main region and histogram regression tests.
expected_results: Focused tests pass with bounded ownership; native/device limitations are reported honestly and final corpus qualification remains TASK-004.

tasks.description: Integrate the minimap widget, view-only navigation and targeted background rendered proof.
extra_context: Consumes TASK-001 geometry/projection and TASK-002 ready/updating/unavailable overview seam. This task delivers the useful feature with ordinary correctness and rendered integration checks.
Owner-chosen interaction is click-to-centre and drag the rectangle, with grab offset, letterbox rejection and edge clamp. Layout/theming details are delegated within the design.

Widget owns pointer capture only. Use existing immediate local pan, one-in-flight/latest-pending owner synchronization and actual scrollable positioning; prevent late responses from undoing newer state.

Route starting events inside minimap before brush/picker/crop/divider/Space-drag/main pinch input. Release, Escape and focus loss end navigation without changing an underlying draft. Wheel follows ordinary pan; handle focus/keyboard nudge through existing view semantics where the framework supports focus.

Add minimap state/bounds/identity/rectangle and overview counters to snapshot evidence. Extend the existing zoom journey with actual semantic press/move/release through the UI navigation path, plus equivalent same-client API pan.

acceptance_criteria: Card appears automatically at inclusive 200% through all zoom entry points, remains anchored with panels hidden and never expands the image scroll area.
Click/drag moves the actual main view with unchanged zoom; clamping, centred axes, out-of-card release, Escape and focus loss agree with the shared geometry.
Pointer/pinch interception prevents brush, pick, crop and divider edits; draft state, recipe, history and histogram identity remain unchanged by navigation.
Crop, historical, comparison, unavailable, updating and rapid asset/stage switches honor the design with no stale actionable rectangle.
Native background zoom evidence correlates threshold visibility, pixels, minimap/main bounds, UI and API pan, request logs and overview reuse; zero overview upload/rebuild is proved on ordinary pan.

steps: Run narrow app/widget tests covering request sequences, session adoption, scrollable placement, gesture interception and threshold derivation.
Run the extended existing zoom scenario through its background launcher; inspect captures and assert against independent geometry rather than only snapshot values.
Include a drafted brush/picker/crop interception and comparison navigation integration case; source checksums and recipe/history/draft invariants are explicit assertions.
expected_results: A working minimap with ordinary tests and genuine rendered proof is available; extensive corpus/resource measurements follow without a review gate.

tasks.description: Qualify overview output and high-zoom interactions, measure once, and publish current documentation.
extra_context: Consumes the working widget and targeted journey from TASK-003. This task adds broader qualification and final evidence, not an owner approval gate.

Extend existing GPU qualification tooling for settled overview output; all claims use the current declared display tolerance and current corpus. Missing supplied files/native platforms remain explicit unavailable evidence, not hidden passes.

Measure once after feature work: native release on the M4, generated 24 MP/60 MP, warmed/cold overview availability, 199.9% control and 200%/800% interactions. Different region windows prevent an isolated rendering-speed claim; extend existing latency tooling for actual minimap drag when needed.

Update feature status, user guide, workspace design, limits/performance documentation and roadmap/task status with current behavior and evidence. Keep the performance-rules checklist answered once for the finished change.

Automated launches use existing hidden background bundles; ad hoc checks use develop --background with isolated data. A physical foreground feel check is optional owner work outside this plan, never a delivery prerequisite.

acceptance_criteria: Background rendered coverage includes inclusive threshold/fractional/pinch/API zoom, corner drags, fitting axes, resize/scaling/panels, image switches, history, crop/warp/masks/Compare, reference fallback and recovery.
Corpus overview output passes the declared reference tolerance; CPU fixtures remain exact; main-image and histogram correctness remain unchanged.

Native photo-sized measurements report p50/p95 pan-to-frame, first overview latency, retained/peak CPU/GPU bytes, reuse/rebuild/upload counts, cache/host/profile and idle scope; all budget/lifecycle assertions pass.
Documentation describes delivered behavior and outstanding platform/input limits only, with no unrun check claimed passed or proposed method described as shipped.
Final quick and rendered verification pass; updated plans/indexes/links validate. No full milestone claim is made without the full tier.

steps: Complete the acceptance matrix with correlated native state/logs/captures and explicit source/history/draft invariants; verify oversubscribed memory and hidden-window cancellation/recovery.
